explanation: Dune, Oasis, Mirage, and Cactus are all strongly associated with deserts, either as physical features, natural phenomena, or flora. A waterfall is typically found in other geographical regions.

All tokens are traditionally listed as one of the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. However, the Colossus of Rhodes, Lighthouse of Alexandria, Hanging Gardens of Babylon, and Statue of Zeus at Olympia have all been destroyed or vanished over time. The Great Pyramid of Giza is the only one that largely remains intact to this day.

Soccer, Basket, Foot, and Base are all words that combine with 'ball' to form a common sport (Soccer Ball, Basketball, Football, Baseball). 'Head' does not form a recognized sport when combined with 'ball'.
